interpretations: For each `transref` in `sentimentandfundamentals`, average its non-null `anlycount` values. Keep transactions whose average exceeds the unweighted average of all non-null per-transaction averages. Show each kept transaction’s `transref`, its average, its difference from the overall average, and its difference from the average of the kept transactions’ averages. Return the 10 largest by the last difference, with nulls last and no rounding.
queries:
WITH transaction_averages AS (
    SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY transref
    HAVING AVG(anlycount) IS NOT NULL
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
    FROM transaction_averages
),
kept AS (
    SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, oa.overall_avg
    FROM transaction_averages AS ta
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > oa.overall_avg
),
kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg
    FROM kept
)
SELECT
    k.transref,
    k.avg_anlycount,
    k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall,
    k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS difference_from_kept
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
ORDER BY difference_from_kept IS NULL, difference_from_kept DESC
LIMIT 10
